fields.headline: AuraSound Pro Wireless Headphones
fields.summary: Industry-leading noise cancellation, 30-hour battery and multipoint pairing.

reviews.author: Devon Marsh
reviews.headline: The multipoint actually works
reviews.body: Two weeks of commuting and one long-haul flight. They hand off between my laptop and phone without the half-second of silence every other pair I have owned makes you sit through. Battery went from full to 40% over the flight with ANC on the whole way.

reviews.author: Priya Raman
reviews.headline: Superb on planes, warm on hot days
reviews.body: Noise cancelling on engine drone is the best I have tried and the case is genuinely pocketable. The earpads do get warm after about two hours in summer, which is the only reason this is not a five.

reviews.author: Tomas Lind
reviews.headline: Replaced a pair twice the price
reviews.body: Bought these to leave at the office and ended up carrying them everywhere. Transparency mode is clear enough to order coffee without taking them off.
